## Blueprint vs instance

A class defines fields (state) and methods (behavior). `new` creates an instance and runs a constructor.

## Encapsulation

Make fields `private` and expose behavior through methods. This keeps invariants safe.

## this and constructors

`this` refers to the current instance. Constructors can call one another with `this(...)`; a subclass calls the parent with `super(...)`.
